questions.prompt: Which approach best supports reliable work with Promise Combinators?
options: Skip input validation because Node.js applications run on a trusted server.
Assume every supported runtime has identical APIs and scheduling behavior.
Store credentials and production secrets directly in the source file.
Use await with try/catch, run independent tasks concurrently with bounded concurrency, and make cancellation/retries explicit.
questions.answer_key: Use await with try/catch, run independent tasks concurrently with bounded concurrency, and make cancellation/retries explicit.

questions.prompt: Before relying on a Promise Combinators implementation, what verification is most useful?
